copy.title: WHY THEY STOP RESPONDING

steps.why: before someone ghosts, their brain runs a price comparison: discomfort now versus silence forever.
the moment saying nothing feels easier than saying something, the exit door opens.

steps.rule: Watch how long the discomfort lasts
steps.why: an awkward conversation ends in minutes; an ignored message festers for weeks.

steps.rule: Name the story they are protecting
steps.why: people disappear to avoid being seen as the one who said no, not to avoid you.

steps.rule: Stop making honesty cost them more
steps.why: when you punish hard truths with anger, you guarantee the next truth never arrives.

copy.kicker: Silence is just cheap conflict with a delay
copy.thumb_scene: Wick stands on a plain white studio background, phone held flat in one open palm, screen facing up showing a long unanswered message thread, his other hand raised slightly as if mid-realisation, looking directly into camera with a calm, knowing expression.
copy.send_to: the friend still waiting on a reply that is never coming
